name: shadcnui-hono-jsx
description: shadcn/ui-compatible components for Hono JSX, without React.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/types/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/types/tsconfig.strict.json
scripts.examples:test: bun run --filter example-hono test && bun run --filter example-honox smoke
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run generate --check && bun run registry:validate
scripts.verify:full: bun run verify && bun run examples:build && bun run examples:typecheck && bun run examples:test && bun run test:registry
